item.coloph: de ltar rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro yi/ sgrab mchog yid bzhin nor bu las/ shog chung gud du bkol ba 'di/ phyi rabs gshen gyi don ched du/ stong (stang) chen bdag gis yi ger bkod/ skal ldan khyed la snyan du brgyud/ gsang sbas thabs la mkhas par gyis/ skal ldan gcig brgyud ma gtogs pas/ dam nyams rigs la ma bstan cig/
